# Dewatermark Platform

> Open-source, self-hosted, local-first AI video watermark removal platform with a FastAPI API, async worker, SQLite job state, local storage, provider fallback, and ComfyUI / DiffuEraser integration.

## Canonical Project Facts

- Project name: `Dewatermark Platform`
- Repository: `https://github.com/tytsxai/dewatermark-platform`
- License: MIT
- Primary language: Python
- Runtime stack: FastAPI, Uvicorn, SQLite WAL, local filesystem, worker process, ComfyUI, DiffuEraser, FFmpeg fallback
- Primary use case: video watermark removal jobs submitted through HTTP API and processed asynchronously by a local worker
- Intended deployment: local machine, private GPU workstation, internal server, or self-hosted workflow node
- Current media support: `video` jobs only for `POST /v1/jobs`; accepted extensions are `mp4`, `mov`, and `mkv`
- Current providers: `comfy_diffueraser` and `local_fallback`
- Production guard: with `DWM_ENV=production`, startup fails until `DWM_DEFAULT_API_KEY` is changed from `dev-secret-key`

## What This Project Is

`Dewatermark Platform` is a backend platform for developers who need an API-first, self-hosted video dewatermark service. It is suitable for bots, web back offices, automation scripts, media cleanup pipelines, and private AI video processing workflows.

## What This Project Is Not

- Not a hosted SaaS watermark-removal website.
- Not a polished commercial effect product.
- Not a copyright or DRM bypass tool.
- Not a multi-node GPU scheduler.
- Not a web admin dashboard.

## Main Capabilities

- Submit video jobs: `POST /v1/jobs`
- List jobs: `GET /v1/jobs`
- Get job status: `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`
- Get result metadata: `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result`
- Cancel queued jobs: `POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel`
- Inspect providers: `GET /v1/providers`
- Health check: `GET /healthz`
- Authentication: `X-API-Key`
- Idempotency: `Idempotency-Key`
- Callback delivery: HMAC-SHA256 signatures and retry outbox
- Runtime commands: `--doctor`, `--runtime-plan`, `--install-runtime`, `--comfyui-plan`, `--comfyui-health`, `--start-comfyui`

## Provider Truths

- `comfy_diffueraser` is the intended AI-first provider. It depends on ComfyUI, custom nodes, workflow JSON files, required model files, and a reachable ComfyUI API.
- `local_fallback` keeps the system runnable. Its default `ffmpeg_copy` mode only copies the input file and should not be described as real AI watermark removal.
- `local_fallback=delogo` uses FFmpeg's delogo filter and requires explicit x/y/w/h coordinates.
